sourceAuthority: CDC/NCHS NHANES public-use DEMO_J plus public-use Linked Mortality File; R survey domain mechanism; Human Infra disclosure and model-admission boundaries.

sourceFindings.observedFact: CDC/NCHS NHANES variance guidance requires domain/subpopulation analysis to retain the full eligible design information rather than dropping records before variance estimation.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: Weighted domain output must be blocked unless the estimator uses a post-design domain indicator or equivalent survey-domain mechanism.

sourceFindings.observedFact: R survey subset.survey.design restricts a survey design to a subpopulation while retaining original design information about clusters and strata.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The controlled runtime smoke can prove only synthetic domain-subset mechanics; public NHANES output still requires public-data domain diagnostics and disclosure review.

sourceFindings.observedFact: CDC/NCHS warns that subgroup degrees of freedom can differ when not all PSUs and strata are represented in a subgroup.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: Public weighted domain output must bind every future output to represented degrees-of-freedom, lonely PSU, empty domain and sparse-domain review before disclosure.

sourceFindings.observedFact: The local domain indicator metadata diagnostic verifies all 8 sex × ageBand aggregate domain combinations without repeating public record counts, death counts, weighted sums, rates, intervals, raw rows or individual rows.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The public-data domain indicator gate can move to ready, while weighted domain output remains blocked by DOF/sparse-domain, disclosure and implementation gates.

sourceFindings.observedFact: The local DOF/sparse-domain diagnostic reviews 8 sex × ageBand public aggregate domains, minimum observed domain degrees of freedom 15, no lonely represented strata, no empty domains and no configured sparse-domain flags, without persisting rows, per-domain counts or per-domain weighted sums.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The public-data DOF/sparse-domain metadata gate can move to ready, while disclosure review, effective-sample-size publication review, confidence intervals and weighted-domain output implementation remain blocked.

sourceFindings.observedFact: The local NHANES disclosure output envelope validator passes 8 synthetic cases: safe aggregate-shaped synthetic outputs are allowed, while unsuppressed small cells, low-DOF unsuppressed cells, row-level flags, identifier-like keys, public AI upload and forbidden real-output types are blocked.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The disclosure-envelope shape gate can move to ready for synthetic validation only; real public weighted-domain output, real confidence intervals, effective sample size publication review and calibration remain blocked.

sourceFindings.observedFact: The local effective sample / confidence interval publication validator passes 9 synthetic cases: publication-ready synthetic cells are allowed, while low effective sample size, unacceptable RSE, unacceptable CI width, low DOF, real CI claims, public AI upload and forbidden real-output types are blocked.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The publication-reliability shape gate can move to ready for synthetic validation only; real weighted-domain output, real confidence intervals, real disclosure review, calibration and individual prediction remain blocked.

sourceFindings.observedFact: The local weighted-output implementation preflight validator passes 8 synthetic cases: complete estimator preflight shapes are allowed, while row-level flags, row-drop-before-design, real weighted-rate claims, public AI upload, public count keys and individual prediction output types are blocked.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The implementation-preflight gate can move to ready for synthetic validation only; it still does not implement real weighted-domain rates, design-based confidence intervals, disclosure review, calibration or individual prediction.

sourceFindings.observedFact: The local disclosure review template validator passes with 15 required review slots and a no-real-output boundary: all slots remain pending, public disclosure review is not complete, and public weighted-domain output remains disallowed.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The disclosure-review-template gate can move to ready as a future review packet scaffold only; real disclosure review, real weighted-domain output, design-based intervals, calibration and individual prediction remain blocked.

sourceFindings.observedFact: The disclosure review execution register validator passes with 15 required slots, 8 machine-prefill-eligible slots, 0 completed human-review slots, no reviewed output hash, no second reviewer signoff and releaseDecision blocked-pending-human-disclosure-review.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The execution-register gate can move to ready as a machine-auditable human-review state model, while real disclosure review completion, public weighted-domain output, calibration and individual prediction remain blocked.

sourceFindings.observedFact: The local disclosure packet runway can bind the ignored local weighted-domain output hash and review slots while omitting real weighted rates, standard errors and design-based confidence intervals from the packet.
sourceFindings.modelConsequence: The local disclosure packet improves auditability of real local output, but it is not human disclosure review completion and does not authorize public weighted-domain output, calibration or individual prediction.

readinessGates.evidence: Upstream weighted-estimator readiness validation passes and still blocks weighted domain output.
Controlled conda runtime validation proves R 4.3.3 + survey can run a synthetic svydesign/domain subset smoke.
The contract requires post-design domain indicators and rejects row drop before design creation.
The contract requires domain DOF, PSU/strata, lonely PSU, empty domain and sparse-domain review before output.
The contract requires public disclosure review, suppression policy and identifiability review before output.
The public NHANES domain indicator metadata diagnostic verifies aggregate domain coverage without repeating row counts, death counts, weighted sums, rates, intervals or individual rows.

The public NHANES DOF/sparse-domain diagnostic reviews 8 sex × ageBand domains, minimum observed domain df 15, no lonely represented strata, no empty domains and no configured sparse-domain flags without persisting rows, counts, weighted sums, rates or intervals.

The NHANES disclosure output envelope validator passes 8 synthetic cases and blocks unsuppressed small cells, low-DOF unsuppressed cells, row-level flags, identifier-like keys, public AI upload and forbidden real-output types.

The NHANES effective sample / CI publication validator passes 9 synthetic cases and blocks low effective sample class, unacceptable RSE, unacceptable CI width, low DOF, real CI claims, public AI upload and forbidden real-output types.

The NHANES weighted-output implementation preflight validator passes 8 synthetic cases and blocks row-level flags, row-drop-before-design, real weighted-rate claims, public AI upload, public count keys and individual prediction output types.
The NHANES disclosure review template validator passes with 15 required review slots, all pending, and keeps public disclosure review incomplete and weighted-domain output disallowed.

The NHANES disclosure review execution register validator passes with all 15 slots present, 0 completed human-review slots, no reviewed output hash, no second reviewer signoff and release still blocked.
No public weighted domain cells, rates, intervals or subgroup summaries have passed disclosure review.
No repository artifact currently computes or stores public NHANES weighted domain rates or design-based intervals.
